title: Job Applications (/dashboard/applied-jobs) Real Data Pipeline, Kanban Synchronization & Candidate Withdrawal
spec:
### 1. MANDATE & PROBLEM STATEMENT
src/services/api/platform.js:956 defines getUserJobApplications as calling getTrackedJobs(userId).
Real job applications submitted via JobApplicationModal.jsx are stored in table applications, but never appear in /dashboard/applied-jobs.
In addition, candidates have no withdrawal mechanism, and applications are not synchronized with the Kanban tracker.

### 2. ARCHITECTURAL SPECIFICATION
1. Connect getUserJobApplications to GET /api/jobs-data/applications/list.
2. Normalize application fields (jobTitle, company, appliedDate, salary, status) in AppliedJobs.jsx.
3. Add candidate withdrawal with confirmation modal calling DELETE /api/jobs-data/applications/:id.
4. Add 1-click 'Track in Kanban' promoting an application to job_tracker with status 'applied'.

### 3. IMPLEMENTATION PLAN
- S1: Update getUserJobApplications in src/services/api/platform.js to fetch from /api/jobs-data/applications/list.
- S2: Update AppliedJobs.jsx field mapping and empty/error states.
- S3: Implement candidate withdrawal flow with confirmation dialog.
- S4: Implement 'Track in Kanban' action in AppliedJobs.jsx.
- S5: Author test suite tests/dir059-applied-jobs.test.mjs.

plan.summary: DIR-059 PLAN (P1). TARGET CHECK + PROVEN DEFECTS (read-only, zero code changed; every finding cites file:line). KEY FINDING: the BACKEND IS ALREADY COMPLETE - every route the spec asks for exists and is owner-scoped: GET /api/jobs-data/applications/list (backend/routes/jobsData.js:277, applicantId taken from req.user.uid and never client-controlled), DELETE /api/jobs-data/applications/:id (jobsData.js:319, 404 when missing and 403 when not the owner), PATCH /api/jobs-data/applications/:id (jobsData.js:300), plus GET/POST/DELETE /api/jobs-data/tracker (179/186/213). So DIR-059 is a CLIENT-side fix; no new backend route is needed. PROVEN DEFECTS: (1) src/services/api/platform.js:956 getUserJobApplications(userId) is literally 'return getTrackedJobs(userId)' - it returns KANBAN tracker rows instead of the applications table, so /dashboard/applied-jobs renders the wrong entity entirely. (2) DATA-SHAPE GAP: the applications table has id, job_id, employer_id, applicant_id, applicant_name, applicant_email, applicant_phone, resume_id, resume_url, cover_letter, status, rating, notes, revision, extra_json, created_at, updated_at - it has NO jobTitle, company, location or salary (those live on jobs via job_id) and repository getApplications() does a bare SELECT * FROM applications with no join. AppliedJobs.jsx:55-63 therefore reads job.jobTitle/job.company/job.location/job.appliedDate which are all undefined, so rows render blank and search/sort by company and date are inert. Enrichment is required. (3) STATUS VOCABULARY MISMATCH: the applications table defaults status to PENDING (uppercase) while AppliedJobs.jsx:118 and :212 count job.status === 'pending' (lowercase), so the Pending tile can never match. (4) No withdrawal and no Kanban promotion exist. PLAN: S1 repoint getUserJobApplications at GET /api/jobs-data/applications/list; S2 normalize each row into the AppliedJobs view model (jobTitle/company/location/salary enriched via getJobById, appliedDate from created_at, status lower-cased) with honest empty/error/unavailable states; S3 add candidate withdrawal behind the Cuba confirm dialog calling DELETE /api/jobs-data/applications/:id with optimistic removal and rollback; S4 add a 1-click Track in Kanban action using the existing createTrackedJob with status applied, made idempotent by detecting an existing tracker row; S5 author tests/dir059-applied-jobs.test.mjs. Constraints: zero schema change, backend routes are already owner-scoped so no RBAC change, and honest failure states (no fabricated rows). Awaiting your GREEN SIGNAL before ACT.
steps: S1: update getUserJobApplications in src/services/api/platform.js to fetch GET /api/jobs-data/applications/list and return the applications array instead of getTrackedJobs

S5: author tests/dir059-applied-jobs.test.mjs (client wiring, field normalization, status vocabulary parity, withdrawal ownership, tracker promotion)
S6: run lint, build and the product matrix, then submit evidence
